subject: Daemon: add read-only /attempt/diff endpoint
description: Foundation for code-judging. Add a read-only HTTP endpoint (e.g. GET /attempt/diff?key=<task_key>) that returns the diff of an attempt branch against its base: full diff text + a --stat summary. Reuse existing git plumbing in lib/git.js (the git(ws,args) primitive + branchName(key)); resolve the target repo the same way merge_attempt does (configure_task repo_path → task field → workspace, via resolveRepo). Daemon stays dumb — it computes nothing, just shells `git diff <base>...orch/attempt/<key>` and `--stat` and returns the text. No mutation. Wire it into the routes (likely routes/task.js alongside /peek, or routes/exec.js). Add a get_dependency-style read so the judge skill can fetch it. Expose via an MCP tool wrapper in lib/mcp-core.js so the judge subagent can call it. Verify with a manual curl against an existing orch/attempt/* branch.

summary: Added read-only GET /attempt/diff?key=<task_key> returning { ok, key, branch, base, stat, diff }. branch=orch/attempt/<slugify(key)> (git.branchName); base=current/default branch (currentBranch); stat=`git diff base...branch --stat`, diff=full three-dot (merge-base) diff so only the attempt's own changes show. Repo resolved via resolveRepo(key, repo_path, ov, ws) — same order as /git/merge (explicit repo_path > task repo field > workspace). Errors: 400 no key, 409 repo not a git repo, 404 branch missing. New git.attemptDiff(ws, key) helper in lib/git.js (no mutation, shells gitSafe). MCP read tool get_attempt_diff({ task_key, repo_path? }) in lib/mcp-core.js -> GET /attempt/diff. NOTE: live daemon must be restarted to serve the new route.
